verdict.rationale: Unleash documents a comprehensive Admin API and an official MCP server that lets coding assistants create and manage feature flags. Separately, change requests can require an approval step before any change lands in an environment such as production, though they are listed as a hosted or enterprise feature. missing for 10: explicit documentation that API/MCP-originated changes are routed through change requests, any documented CLI, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent changes being gated by approval.
